ai_sol_system = {
	class = "sc_g"
	flags = { sol_system com_sol sol empire_home_system }
	usage = misc_system_init
	init_effect = {
		create_country = { name = "NAME_United_Nations_of_Earth" type = default }
		spawn_system = { initializer = com_sol_neighbor_t1 }
		spawn_system = { initializer = com_sol_neighbor_t1_first_colony }
	}
}

com_sol_neighbor_t1 = {
	class = sc_m
	flags = { com_barnards_star }
	init_effect = {
		spawn_system = { initializer = com_sol_neighbor_t2_second_colony }
		spawn_system = { initializer = sol_neighbor_t2_no_guaranteed_colony }
	}
}

com_sol_neighbor_t1_first_colony = {
	class = sc_trinary_1
	flags = { neighbor_t1_first_colony }
	init_effect = {
		spawn_system = { initializer = sol_neighbor_t2 }
	}
}

com_sol_system = {
	class = "sc_g"
	flags = { sol_system com_sol sol empire_home_system }
	usage = misc_system_init
	usage_odds = {
			base = 0
			modifier = {
				any_playable_country = {
					is_human_species = yes
					OR = {
						has_country_flag = human_2
						has_country_flag = human_3
					}
				}
				NOR = {
					any_country = { has_country_flag = human_1 }
					any_system = { has_star_flag = sol }
					has_star_flag = empire_cluster
				}
				is_fe_cluster = no
				is_marauder_cluster = no
				add = 99999
			}
		}
	max_instances = 1
	init_effect = {
		create_country = { name = "NAME_United_Nations_of_Earth" type = default }
		spawn_system = { initializer = com_sol_neighbor_t1 }
		spawn_system = { initializer = com_sol_neighbor_t1_first_colony }
	}
}

init_sol_geocentric = {
	class = "sc_g"
	flags = { geocentric_sol sol suppress_archaeological_sites }
}

lost_colony_sol_neighbor_t1 = {
	class = sc_m
	flags = { lost_colony_barnards_star }
	init_effect = {
		spawn_system = { initializer = lost_colony_sol_neighbor_t2_second_colony }
		spawn_system = { initializer = sol_neighbor_t2_no_guaranteed_colony }
	}
}

lost_colony_sol_neighbor_t1_first_colony = {
	class = sc_trinary_1
	flags = { neighbor_t1_first_colony }
	init_effect = {
		spawn_system = { initializer = sol_neighbor_t2 }
	}
}

lost_colony_sol_system = {
	class = "sc_g"
	flags = { sol_system lost_colony_sol sol empire_home_system }
	usage = misc_system_init
	usage_odds = {
			base = 0
			modifier = {
				any_playable_country = {
					has_origin = origin_lost_colony
					is_human_species = yes
					NOR = {
						has_country_flag = human_2
						has_country_flag = human_3
					}
				}
				NOT = { any_system = { has_star_flag = sol } }
				NOT = { has_star_flag = empire_cluster }
				is_fe_cluster = no
				is_marauder_cluster = no
				add = 99999
			}
		}
	max_instances = 1
	init_effect = {
		spawn_system = { initializer = lost_colony_sol_neighbor_t1 }
		spawn_system = { initializer = lost_colony_sol_neighbor_t1_first_colony }
	}
}

	}
}
